How to sign a PDF on your phone

PaperVault · November 12, 2026 · 4 min read

To sign a PDF on your phone, open the correct document in a PDF signing app, add your signature in the requested place, and inspect the saved copy before returning it. First check whether the recipient requires a particular e-signature service or signing procedure.

Check the signing request first

Some documents accept a signature placed directly on the PDF; others require a dedicated service, identity check, witness, or particular signing sequence. Read the sender's instructions before editing the file. If you are unsure whether a drawn or inserted signature is acceptable for an important agreement, ask the recipient or a qualified professional.

Add a signature to a PDF

  1. Open the final version of the document and confirm it is the one you were asked to sign.
  2. Choose a PDF tool with a signature feature. PaperVault lists Sign PDF among its tools.
  3. Create or select your signature and place it in the designated signature area.
  4. Resize it so it is legible and does not cover labels, dates, or other text. Add a date only if the document asks for one.
  5. Save a signed copy under a clear filename, then reopen it to check every page and the signature placement.
  6. Return the signed file using the channel and format the recipient requested.

Do not overlook the final review

Check that the signature appears on the intended page and that no other content moved or became obscured. Make sure the saved file is not an unfinished draft. Keep an unsigned original when you may need to make corrections, and avoid sending the document to the wrong contact or an untrusted file-sharing service.

Signature image versus signing workflow

A visible signature added to a PDF is not automatically equivalent to every electronic-signature process or legal requirement. Requirements vary by recipient, document type, and location. A contract, government form, or financial document may specify a particular signing service. Follow that instruction rather than assuming any markup will be accepted.

Privacy reminder: A signed PDF may include personal or financial information. Confirm the recipient and review the entire file before sharing it.
